auditType: independent second visual and mathematical review
method: Personally viewed every original PNG page PDF 461–511 and compared the complete English transcription and Chinese translation, including every paragraph, formula, proof, example, exercise, hint, condition, source note and page fragment. All LaTeX diagram arrows and labels were compared with the original pages. Equivalent constants, reciprocal existential parameters and inherited hypotheses were checked in context rather than treated as errors.

findings.change: Corrected geometric simple point from 单点 to 非奇异点.
findings.independentVerification: The paragraph concerns a point with nonzero partial derivative D_(n+1), which is a nonsingular point; it does not describe a singleton.

findings.change: Added adjacent visible Chinese multiplicity clarification to the printed instruction to replace the norm product by a sum; retained the English source.
findings.independentVerification: For distinct K-embeddings sigma and inseparable degree p^r, trace is p^r sum sigma(alpha), not sum (sigma(alpha))^(p^r). In K=F2(s^2), E=F2(s), multiplication by 1 is a two-dimensional identity map with trace 2=0, whereas summing the unique norm factor gives 1. This example also obeys the printed alpha in K range.

findings.change: Corrected simple point to 非奇异点 and made the neighborhood assertion a neighborhood of P consisting of nonsingular K-rational points.
findings.independentVerification: The preceding nonzero derivative condition and several-variable perturbation argument assert openness of the nonsingular locus around the given point.

contextualChecks.result: Reciprocal lambda parameters still prove the existential dependence statement; only the reversed strict comparison requires correction.
nC versus (n+1)C is a choice of an unspecified bound, since replacing C by 2C preserves the nC estimate; original argument remains valid.
No missing Banach completeness hypothesis imposed on Gelfand–Mazur normed algebra statement; passage to the Banach completion justifies resolvent series arguments.
Corollary 7.3 first correction must be pi^r at v=0; f=X-pi,A=0,r=1 strictly disproves the printed series beginning at pi^(r+1).

Exercise 15 requires residue characteristic p>0: if p is a unit, (1+pi)^p-1 has order exactly 1. Exercise 16 also requires k perfect, since R^p=R forces k^p=k; F_p(t)((pi)) is a counterexample otherwise.
psi_i(0)!=0 is interpreted as at least one coefficient, as irreducibility only rules out a common X factor; printed Witt exponent p^(-i) is preserved.
